messages.text: The source confirms three candidate generators, Clap-specific validation text, automatic encrypted-entry selection, and both ZipCrypto/AES handling. Exact parity now depends on separating deterministic output from terminal-only progress rendering, so I’m probing the reference under redirected streams and reading the remaining implementation boundaries in full before writing the architecture and verifier.
